aboutText: Based in Sunshine North, we have over 15 years of industry expertise in sandblasting and abrasive blasting. Our team is fully qualified with $20M public liability insurance, providing environmentally friendly solutions for both commercial and residential projects. From Alfred Hospital to local homes, we deliver outstanding results with modern equipment.
